body.x: DJI(www.dji.com) announced 'Phantom 2 Vision' at 'CES Unveiled' of the 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

The PHANTOM 2 Vision which is consumer-focused quadcopter with integrated HD camera brings integrated 1080p HD video and iOS / Android camera control. This is a breakthrough for image capture for ease of use and technology. The PHANTOM 2 Vision provides the capability to capture full HD video and pictures right out of the box. And a staggering 25 Mins flight time is achievable with the on board high capacity lipo battery and larger more efficient self tightening propellers.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
